# A config written for vens v0.6 or earlier has no schema_version. vens
# refuses it while loading the config, before it reads the report: the error
# comes even when the report does not exist.

! exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=old.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 missing-report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'config.yaml has no schema_version: it was written for vens v0.6 or earlier \(schema 1\)'
stderr 'Read https://venslabs.github.io/vens/reference/config-schema/#migrating, then add `schema_version: 2` at the top of the file.'
! stderr 'missing-report'
! exists out.cdx.json

# schema_version 1 gets the same pointer.
! exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=v1.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'schema_version 1 is not supported: this vens reads schema 2 only. Read https://venslabs.github.io/vens/reference/config-schema/#migrating, then set `schema_version: 2`.'
! exists out.cdx.json

# The old config with only the marker added loads, with one warning per field
# it leaves undeclared, saying what its worst case does: audit_requirement
# stands in for no traceability, nor the ids control for detection.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=marked.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'level=WARN msg="context.audit_requirement no longer moves any score, and context.traceability is not declared: Loss of accountability uses its `none` column, 7 when the attacker must authenticate and cannot act as someone else or tamper with the records, 9 otherwise."'
stderr 'level=WARN msg="controls ids/siem/edr give no detection credit, and context.detection is not declared: every channel counts as not logged, so Intrusion detection is 9 on every finding."'
stderr 'level=WARN msg="context.data_subjects is not declared: Privacy violation has no cap, so the model''s band stands wherever Privacy violation is asked, and every finding is rated on its technical impact. Declared, it is taken as the business information OWASP''s rule asks for, and every finding is rated on its business impact instead, which can move a severity up or down; with no framework in compliance_requirements, no finding rates critical unless business_criticality is critical."'
! stderr '(?s)(level=WARN.*){4}msg="Config loaded"'
stderr 'msg="Config loaded" schema_version=2 .* listener=unknown undeclared=context.data_subjects,context.detection,context.traceability$'
exists out.cdx.json

# The old config with the marker added and the four new fields declared loads
# with no warning. (The empty report's own warning comes after the load.)
exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=migrated.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json out.cdx.json
! stderr '(?s)level=WARN.*msg="Config loaded"'
stderr 'msg="Config loaded" schema_version=2 .* listener=present undeclared=""$'
exists out.cdx.json

-- old.yaml --
project:
  name: "old-config"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
  audit_requirement: "high"
  controls:
    waf: true
    ids: true
-- v1.yaml --
schema_version: 1
project:
  name: "old-config"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
-- marked.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "old-config"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
  audit_requirement: "high"
  controls:
    waf: true
    ids: true
-- migrated.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "old-config"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
  audit_requirement: "high"
  listener: present
  data_subjects: thousands
  detection:
    network: logged
    host: not_logged
    application: logged_and_reviewed
  traceability: per_request
  controls:
    waf: true
    ids: true
-- report.json --
{"SchemaVersion": 2, "Results": []}
